notes.title: Open Beta Update
notes.content:
Hi Fellows - Thanks so much for your patience and understanding as we try to resolve the server and queue issues we've experienced today. Trust us, we want you all to successfully get into the Beta -- we know you all have been waiting for it!

Wanted to share an update: The investigation surrounding the issues is still ongoing, and we're looking into every possible way of getting this resolved as quickly as possible. We've been actively investigating the issues since Open Beta began, and need a slight break to rest for a few hours (it's late in Sweden!) After some much needed rest, tomorrow, we will continue to troubleshoot and hope to resolve the issues.

Thanks again for all of your support, and we hope everything will be resolved tomorrow so you all can jump into the Beta!

notes.title: Early Access Launch Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="yBlcVdX5siY;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hi Fellows!

We’ve got an update for you regarding our planned Steam Early Access release date for Fellowship. In the video linked above, Community Director Hamish explains the release date update, upcoming changes and dives into a few other important topics!

In case you’re in a hurry, here’s a summary of the video and a few additional notes:

Steam Early Access Launch Date: We’ve made the decision to push back the release date by one week. 


You'll be able to play Fellowship in Steam Early Access on October 16th instead of October 9th!

We know you all want to jump in the game ASAP (trust us, we can’t wait for you all to jump in!), but there are a couple of key reasons for this very small shift with the Early Access release date:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/a39d794433e112ae2269e9bfb72e8dd18654cdf0.jpg"]

More time for changes & polish: The slight delay gives us the opportunity to put in extra polish and ensure the best possible experience for you all on day one when Fellowship enters Steam Early Access! As you all know, we’ve been having our private playtest recently – which has helped us identify changes we can make to the game. Having some additional development time, even if it's only a week (a week goes a long way!) will allow us to make the changes and polish we want to make so Fellowship is the best it can be when it enters Early Access on October 16th!  



To address the elephant in the room – we want to give Fellowship it’s time to shine: There are major game releases happening the week we originally planned to enter Early Access. Following Gamescom, we saw your all’s concerns about launching Fellowship during a major week for highly-anticipated game releases and recognized of course you all (like us!) wanted to make sure Fellowship has its time to shine in the spotlight. We always want to be transparent with our community and get your feedback, and this is no different! By launching Fellowship in Steam Early Access on October 16, it allows us to make sure the game does get in the spotlight and get the attention we and you all think it deserves!

Open Beta – No changes: No changes here, we absolutely can’t wait for you all to jump in! The Open Beta via Steam will still kick off on Thursday, September 18 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time and end on Tuesday, September 23 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time. For the Open Beta, there will be a North America, Europe and Asia server available, and servers will be online 24/7! You can request access to the Open Beta via the game’s Steam page to be notified immediately when the Open Beta goes live.

At the very end of this blog, we have an Open Beta FAQ with quite a few answers to questions folks have asked since we announced the Beta. Make sure to check it out!

Leagues System & Matchmaking Updates: The Leagues System will be a new way to experience progression throughout Fellowship! With the system, you’ll be able to make your way through different leagues as your experience, gear, and item level improves. Matchmaking will set you up with players of similar item level, and you will then be able to pick a dungeon of suitable difficulty. Prepare to complete dungeon runs, enter higher leagues, and reap exciting rewards!

Our matchmaking game modes will remain about the same but will have some quality-of-life changes to make matchmaking even better. For modes, we’ll have Quick Play, and for now, what we’re calling Challenge (previously known as Ranked or Ranked Dungeons). Quick Play, like before, offers a more casual experience that’d give you a chance to try out new heroes, and not have to worry about gear as your gear will not matter but you’ll of course still have all your usual abilities per character! Our Challenge mode (name to be decided!), will have the Leagues System and really dive deep into the game’s progression, as you’ll work your way up to harder difficulty dungeons. The higher the league you’re in, the more challenging and rewarding dungeons will be!

Localization: Right at Steam Early Access launch on October 16, Fellowship will be playable in the following languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Korean, and Chinese! The game will launch in your chosen Steam language or default to English if it’s not supported.

Fellowship Content from Creators: Leading up to our Open Beta and during the beta, you’ll be able to watch some of your favorite creators play Fellowship on Twitch and YouTube. Beyond Open Beta, there’ll be even more content from press and content creators to be shared before, on and even after Early Access launch. Keep an eye on our social media channels and join our Discord to not miss out on anything!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/636ac1b9229b99365b2113b864778af867766c6d.jpg"]
Open Beta FAQ
If you made it this far, thanks for sticking around! Below’s a quick FAQ addressing some questions we spotted since we announced the Beta. We’ll share this FAQ again when the Open Beta launches, so no need to memorize it!

There really is no signup, payment or key required?
Correct, there is no need to sign up, key or fee required for the Open Beta! It’ll be open to everyone!

How do I get into the Open Beta?
During the time of Open Beta from September 18 to September 23, you can head to Fellowship’s Steam page, click the “Join the Fellowship Playtest” to download the Open Beta build, and once it’s downloaded, you can jump in and play. 

If you’d like immediately to know when the Beta is live (or just need a friendly reminder!), you can request access now via Fellowship’s Steam page.

When can I play exactly?
The Open Beta runs from September 18 at 10am PT (7pm CEST) to September 23 at 10 am PT (7pm CEST) and Fellowship will be fully playable for that whole time.

Can I stream/capture my gameplay?
There will be no NDA for this Open Beta. Streaming/video capture and talking about the playtest is highly encouraged!

What Heroes are available?
There will be 7 heroes for players to choose from during the Open Beta: 2 Tanks, 3 DPS, and 2 Healers. We’ll most notably have a new Melee DPS, Mara, available, and be bringing back Ardeos, everyone’s favorite fire-throwing DPS! 

Will there be any new content in the Open Beta compared to the last playtest back in February?
There will be! Compared to the Steam Next Fest demo back in February, in addition to introducing a new DPS hero, Mara, the Open Beta will introduce new gameplay systems, including a fresh take on matchmaking and group finding, and an engaging progression system including Weapons, Gems, Talents, Crafting, Legendary items and more. Additionally, the Open Beta will introduce a new dungeon “Urrak Markets”, new gameplay features like cosmetic customization allowing you to change the look of different pieces of armor, new Gear, new Mounts, new visual element improvements and improvements on previous gameplay mechanics based on Steam Next Fest player feedback. The Open Beta will allow us to test multiplayer matchmaking improvements we’ve made and give us the chance to get one final round of player feedback before Fellowship’s Early Access launch.

Will there be servers in my region? 
There are NA, EU, and Asian servers available during the Public Playtest.

What languages are the Open Beta available in?
We are planning to have the Open Beta available in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Korean, and Chinese.

How do I share my feedback?
Join our Discord! Feedback can be shared in the ⁠#game-feedback channel.

What do I do if I encounter an issue during the Open Beta?
As this is still a Beta build, you may occasionally encounter issues with your game. If you do, please report them in the ⁠#bug-reports ⁠channel on Discord so our teams can track them.

notes.title: Fellowship Launches In Early Access On October 16!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Fellowship will be available on Steam in Early Access on October 16, 2025 for $24.99. 

Before Early Access launch, you’ll be able to play during our Open Beta via Steam from September 18 until September 23! 

ABOUT EARLY ACCESS
The upcoming Early Access launch will mark just the beginning of Fellowship, as the game will be a constantly evolving adventure with a slew of content that will be added and evolve thanks to YOUR feedback throughout the course of Early Access. Our community comes first, and we take pride in working very closely with our most dedicated fans to create and shape the game over the various stages of development.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/4fdaec1d4676bb5be527325a38b2824d332a6de6.jpg"]From the very beginning of Early Access, you will be able to experience the core vision of Fellowship: all dungeons, all the time – giving you the action you want right from the start. Following Early Access launch, there are plans for optional cosmetic purchases to be available. We'd like to make clear that these items will be purely cosmetic and not affect gameplay. More details on these items will be revealed sometime closer to Early Access launch.

Fellowship is planned to be in Early Access for approximately six months, but this can change depending on your feedback – as we will strive to discover what the community wants in Fellowship to help shape it into the best possible game it can be before it enters 1.0 launch next year. For the full 1.0 version of the game, we're planning on including more content, systems, and features. We have several plans in mind for content and features, but as mentioned before, we will also take your feedback to heart and may make adjustments if we hear that there’s something you really want to see in the game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/3040363ade798883517171db7b550fc8604dc13d.jpg"]
JOIN THE OPEN BETA!
Our upcoming Open Beta on Steam will kick off on Thursday, September 18 at 10am Pacific Time and end on Tuesday, September 23 at 10am Pacific Time. For the Open Beta, there will be a North America, Europe and Asia server available. This playtest will you the chance to experience seven heroes (two Tanks, three DPS – including our recently-revealed DPS, Mara, and two Healers) who will be in Fellowship’s diverse roster of heroes, go on dungeon runs (both Ranked Dungeons and Quick Play Dungeons), take on challenging enemies and acquire epic loot along the way.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/9beccea2429425d0333f34ed82645e33c1153127.jpg"]Compared to the Steam Next Fest demo back in February, in addition to introducing a new DPS hero, Mara, the Open Beta will introduce new gameplay systems, including a fresh take on matchmaking and group finding, and an engaging progression system including Weapons, Gems, Talents, Crafting, Legendary items and more. Additionally, the Open Beta will introduce a new dungeon “Urrak Markets”, new gameplay features like cosmetic customization allowing you to change the look of different pieces of armor, new Gear, new Mounts, new visual element improvements and improvements on previous gameplay mechanics based on Steam Next Fest player feedback. The Open Beta will allow us to test multiplayer matchmaking improvements we’ve made and give us the chance to get one final round of player feedback before Fellowship’s Early Access launch.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/fa56cf93dc479e395255e186883fd1a7f97193bb.jpg"]If you want to let us know your feedback as well, please join our wonderful community on Discord. In addition to discussing the game with fellow fans and finding players for dungeon runs, our dedicated feedback channel will be available for your input, and the dev team can’t wait to hear from you!

notes.title: Dev Update - Big News & Interview
notes.content:
Hi Fellows! 

In case you missed it, there's been A LOT of updates for Fellowship recently. So many updates, we decided to come up with a nice Dev Update for you to catch up on all the news. Sit back and catch up on the latest and greatest -- and even check out an interview with Game Director, Axel Lindberg.
[previewyoutube="dhGYwFvveZc;full"][/previewyoutube]
For Fellows who prefer a list of updates to read, we've got you covered: 

Private Playtest - Next Week: Happening as soon as next week! We plan to invite both new playtest players and returning playtest players. Details to come soon, stay tuned! If you haven't already, join our playtest waitlist: https://fellowship.firstlook.gg/. Note though that this playtest will be under NDA. 

Future Games Show - Two BIG Announcements - Next Wednesday, August 20: Tune into Future Games Show and Future Games Show Live from Gamescom next Wednesday, August 20! We'll share a BIG announcement for both shows -- one of which will include an interview with Hamish Bode, our Community Director. See the banners below for times each show is happening and mark your calendar. We'll also be at Gamescom to let press and content creators to check out some never-before-seen content. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/b1b7f1215cbb19a43c8cda71449c85786725b897.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/e059f998d56949e3dff51de45787a39a0b1254c1.png"]

Echo Partnership: We're working with Echo (aka: Echo Esports, one of the biggest MMO guilds) on quite a few opportunities! Tune into their Race to World First livestream to see a few things from us. 

New Hero, Mara, Revealed: That's right, we've revealed a new hero... Mara! Mara's a melee DPS assassin who uses stealth to get up close and personal to land surprising and devasting attacks. If you haven't already, check out our recent videos on Mara (1,2,3) for more details on this new hero. 

That's it... for now! Next week will be a fun one, and we absolutely can't wait to reveal our big announcements then. 



Cheers,

Chief Rebel

notes.title: Fellowship Hero Spotlight Series
notes.content:
Hi Fellows!

We’re back with a new series of trailers for you, giving you a closer look at each of the playable heroes in Fellowship. Bookmark this article, as we’ll be updating it with new spotlight entries over the next weeks!

[previewyoutube=SHz3aN5LsJ0;full][/previewyoutube]
Mara
Mara is a melee DPS assassin who uses stealth to get up close and personal to land surprising and devasting attacks. In combat, generate combo points and use them on special abilities to empower them for more damage!

[previewyoutube=mFUh0dJRbAE;full][/previewyoutube]
Helena
Helena will take a hit for you on the frontlines. Build up toughness to reduce incoming damage and retaliate with powerful strikes. Shield your allies and forge a path for your group!

[previewyoutube=emnSHgZD7-Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Vigour
Vigour is a healer that thrives in the midst of battle alongside allies. Build up radiant runes to unleash powerful abilities like granting shields or damaging enemies while healing allies. Support and help your allies as Vigour!

[previewyoutube=VBWZF_aL5zU;full][/previewyoutube]
Rime
Rime is a ranged caster who deals massive damage from afar. Step back from the heat of battle and wield the power of frost, which will eventually generate Winter Orbs. Use them to unleash winter’s wrath with even more devastating elemental abilities!

[previewyoutube=x-OMnTfGOLY;full][/previewyoutube]
Meiko
Meiko is a melee tank who utilizes different martial fighting techniques to empower herself and defend her allies. With Combo Builder abilities, you will ultimately get access to various Finishing Moves, unleashing powerful abilities.

notes.title: Developer Update: Public Playtest Wrap-Up & What’s Next
notes.content:
Hi Fellows! 

It’s been just a little over a month since our Public Playtest (demo) for Steam Next Fest – which ICYMI went extremely well to say the least (see the infographic below) – but we wanted to take a moment to share a Developer Update video that addresses your playtest feedback, how we plan to improve Fellowship based on the feedback and what’s next for the game as we get it ready for Early Access launch. Be sure to check out the video as it has a few things we’ve been working on lately based on your feedback! 

[previewyoutube=c9zv5T6l-tQ;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/877a7834db0ad7db3e8c830ea08b068006139a41.jpg

We’ll be spending the next few months focused on developing Fellowship, but don’t worry, we won’t be silently working.  We will still be giving you all updates as we continue development. Updates will include sharing news (yes, that includes news of the Early Access release date – we’ll have news on that when we’re ready!), videos/trailers, dev team blogs, and last but certainly not least giving you all a chance to take a look on what we’re working on along the way.  

Aside from giving wider updates, we also have our Fellowship Community Council, our new community program where we’ve hand-picked and will continue to hand-pick a group of players – from competitive players to players that are new to this type of game, and give these players the chance to connect directly with us! For the program, folks that are in it can get exclusive access to in-development builds of Fellowship (under NDA, of course) and give us feedback in real-time to shape the future of our game. If you’re interested in joining the council, send Hamish, our Community Director, a DM via Discord, share with him why you’d be a good fit, and he’ll make sure to add you to the list for consideration to join the council. 

That’s it for today’s dev update, but we’re thrilled to continue development on Fellowship after all the incredible feedback we got from you all from the Public Playtest! We can’t wait to share more updates as we work on getting Fellowship ready for Early Access launch later this year.  

Cheers, 

Chief Rebel Team

notes.title: Community Accolades from Public Playtest & Fellows Assembly
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We’d like to take a moment to share some incredible, positive feedback from you all on what YOU loved about the demo (Public Playtest)! The playtest was something we’ve worked on for a long time and it’s just amazing to see that all that work has paid off after all the glowing praise we received. Needless to say, we were blown away by the praise – from seeing that Fellowship was the 5th most-played Steam Next Fest demo to getting a 92% very positive rating for the Steam demo and then just reading all of your positive feedback each day of the playtest... the playtest was a major, uplifting moment for us. We’re incredibly thankful for having such a spectacular, positive and fun community – it inspires us to continue to keep doing what we’re doing: making our dream game for you all!  


 "The sheer amount of information you can convey without solely relying on vocal communication is amazing, markers, routing, interrupt timers, it feels nice and doesn't feel overloading." - @Cryokhai92
 "Fun and fast gameplay, quick to get into the action and unlock new abilities. Would love to see a more in depth itemization system instead of just higher ilvl=better, also interested to see if different weapons (when added) could impact stuff like Tariq's swing timer. Overall A+" - @banishedPickles
 "Meiko’s combo system was really well done. Favorite tank of the two for sure." - @Tro0123
 "The dungeon %s and routes felt great as a tank (I only played Meiko the entire test because of how fun she was). I really enjoyed being able to see your party's interrupt cooldown over the mobs nameplate, as well as boss timers without having to use addons. Can't wait for more!" - @Siegewarcraft_
 "A refreshing take on every role! Every character filled a specific power fantasy and extremely varied gameplay, it's so wonderful to see only 6 different characters but every single one catering to a different feeling of playing the game."- @MastodonFG
  "It was very cool how easy we found other People to Play and Team up with. Playstyle of Sylvie was very fun and had good room for growth. Armor also looked very pretty" - @Celialuena


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/d1e33218f2ede74d03470f76767f170fff39480c.png

Now of course, we know that there are things we can improve and evolve with Fellowship – that's why we wanted to have the playtest to hear from you directly on what the future of Fellowship could look like. So, in case you missed it, join our Community Director TODAY at 2pm PT on Fellowship’s Discord for our first Fellows Assembly via a special Discord event: https://discord.com/events/1254866410258038845/1348776973719306371 For this event, we'd love to hear from you about your best and not-so-best experiences from our recent playtest! We’d like to listen to your feedback directly and will be taking notes that we’ll share with the full Chief Rebel team. 

Much love, 
Chief Rebel

notes.title: Surprise! Demo Available Until Tomorrow!
notes.content:
Fellows, we have a BIG surprise! We’ve decided to have the Public Playtest (Demo) available until tomorrow (March 4th) at 10:00am PT! 🙌 

We want to give you all even more time to play the demo across all servers and continue to go on epic dungeon runs. Yesterday, we noticed that the North America server was experiencing lag spikes (sorry about that!) We’d like to get to the bottom of what the issue could be on the NA server side, so if possible, please play on that server to help us out there. 🛠️ 

Heads up that Fellowship will undergo maintenance later today. 📜 We'll give an update about this when everything's set up on our end.

Thank you all SO much for your support and feedback, and we’re thrilled to give you all even more time to play Fellowship! 💯

notes.title: Public Playtest Patch Notes - March 1
notes.content:
Hi Fellows! 

We'll be releasing a patch today to fix crashes and add some balancing changes. We'll be bringing down the servers temporarily for maintenance as well. ⚒️ 

Below are the notes for today's patch.

GENERAL


 Discovered and fixed another issue causing crashes related to cooldown recovery.
 Fixed an issue causing players who rejoin an ongoing dungeon to not be targetable.
 Fixed an issue causing players who rejoin an ongoing dungeon to not get loot from the end of dungeon chest.
 Players who rejoin an ongoing dungeon that have an empty health bar will no longer need to restart the game again. The health bar will update upon taking damage.
 Fixed an issue causing all ability cooldowns to reset when players rejoined an ongoing dungeon.


RELICS


 Fixed the tooltip for Blood Rite Drums. Now correctly states that it provides +50% Cooldown Recovery for the duration of the effect.
 The cooldown of Blood Rite Drums has been increased to 3 minutes, up from 2.5 minutes.
 The cooldown of Salt Wash Elixir has been reduced to 2 minutes, down from 5 minutes.
 The cooldown of Ancient Wardstone has been reduced to 2 minutes, down from 5 minutes.
 The cooldown of Sinbinding Stone has been reduced to 3 minutes, down from 5 minutes.
 The cooldown of Chalice of Al'zerac's Essence has been reduced to 3 minutes, down from 5 minutes.


RIME


 Rime Talent: Avalanche now causes Icy Comet to have a 20% chance to strike twice and a 4% chance to strike three times, down from 30% / 8%.
 Rime Talent: Soulfrost Torrent now increases the damage of Freezing Torrent by 50%, down from 100% - resulting in a total of 200% increased damage on a full channel considering the increased duration of the channel still being double.
 Rime Talent: Soulfrost Torrent's proc per minute reduced to 1.5 (was 2.0).
 Rime Talent: Winter's Blessing now converts 30% of damage to healing, down from 100%.



SYLVIE


 Safe Haven cooldown reduced to 120 seconds, down from 180 seconds.
 Safe Haven duration increased to 15 seconds, up from 12 seconds.
 Safe Haven damage reduction increased to 25%, up from 20%.
 Fluttercall: Jubilee now redistributes health in the group every 2 seconds, down from every 3 seconds.


TARIQ

 Focused Wrath now increases the damage of your next two Skull Crushers or Hammer Storms by 50%, up from 30%.
 Raging Currents damage increased by 50%.


STORMWATCH & DEMONBRAND RUINS


 Mancatchers will now wait longer after initiated to use their Grip ability.
 Mancatcher's Grip damage reduced by 40%.
 The minimum range of Mancatcher's Grip ability has been increased to 1500, up from 1000.


SAILOR'S ABYSS


 Vengeful Shade's Witherbane Toxin now deals damage every 3 seconds, up from every 2 seconds.
 Coral Lasher's Disgorged Muck cooldown increased to 12 seconds, up from 8 seconds.
 Water Elemental's Hydro Bolt cooldown increased to 15 seconds, up from 12 seconds.


THE WYRMHEART


 Coldheart Assassin's Wicked Strikes damage reduced by 20%.
 Coldheart Assassin's Poison Dagger damage reduced by 35%.
 Greater Ice Elemental's Stomp ability damage reduced by 28%.

notes.title: Public Playtest Patch Notes - February 28
notes.content:
GENERAL

 We have increased the maintenance warning timer to 30 minutes, up from 15 minutes. Unfortunately, this requires us to patch the game, so this patch will be the last one with a 15-minute warning.

STABILITY

 Fixed another issue causing crashes when players used Cooldown Reducing talents or effects and Cooldown Recovery. This is the issue that was primarily affecting Rime players, but should also prevent crashes for all heroes related to cooldown reduction.

SPIRIT ABILITY UPDATE

 Spirit ability charge lost upon death has been reduced to 25%, was 50%.

TARIQ

 Auto Attack / Heavy Strike damage increased by 10%.
 Leap Slam damage increased by 15%.
 Raging Tempest's tooltip incorrectly stated that Raging Currents increases critical strike chance by 1.5% per stack. Now correctly states each stack increases critical strike chance by 1%.
 Culling Strike's base damage increased by 33%.
 Added information on Culling Strike's tooltip to clarify that the ability does not affect the swing timer.
 Intimidate cooldown reduced to 150 seconds, down from 180 seconds.
 Intimidated enemies can now take 100% more damage before the fear breaks.
 Talent: Blood & Thunder now increases Chain Lightning damage by 25%, up from 20%.

HELENA

 Helena's maximum Toughness value is based on her strength (1200% of Strength baseline). This has been increased to 1800% Strength.
 Helena's Toughness generation from Shields Up, Shield Slam & successful blocks is also based on her strength. All three abilities now have 50% increased Toughness generation.
 The above 2 changes cause Toughness generation to function the same as before, while reducing the amount of Toughness lost when taking damage, improving her overall damage mitigation.
 The amount of Toughness generated by successful blocks has been increased by an additional 25% (from 4% Toughness per block, to 5%).
 Shields Up duration increased to 12 seconds, up from 8 seconds.

MEIKO

 Serenity no longer has a global Cooldown.
 Stone Shield is now more resilient. The health of each stone has been increased by 33%.
 Talent: Spirited Advance had an issue causing the free applications of Spirited Strikes and Spirited Vortex to not work properly. This has been fixed. 
 KNOWN BUG AND REQUEST: Meiko's "Spirited Advance" talent is causing lag spikes. Until we have a chance to fix it, we recommend Meiko players to not use that talent for now. Sorry for the inconvenience! 
 Talent: Harsh Winds tooltip clarified to indicate that the attack speed slow only affects enemy auto attacks.
 Talent: Forbidden Technique now accumulates 15% of all damage you deal to the target, up from 10%.

RIME

 Talent: Glacial Assault now requires 4 stacks to activate, down from 5.

SYLVIE

 Talent: Bluey's Gambit damage reduction when placed on another player increased to 10%, up from 5%.
 Talent: Bloomin' Boomshrooms now heals allies near the target for 75% intellect per explosion, up from 50%.

PROGRESSION

 All types of Ingots and Aethers will now continue dropping as the difficulty increases.
 Ingot and Aether drop chances continue increasing up to difficulty 24.
 End of dungeon group loot UI updated to support showing up to 8 items for players, as there now is a small chance for players to get all 3 Ingots, all 3 Aethers, an Item, and a Gem in a single chest.
 Fixed an issue with the 'Might of the Minotaur II' ruby gem power causing it to only provide 1% increased intellect for intellect heroes. It now correctly increases intellect by 10%.
 Fixed an issue with item scrapping UI, causing items in the scrap window to become scrapped when a player pressed the "Eject Gem" button.

CURSES

 Blood Shards damage reduced to 2.5%, down from 3% (tooltip incorrectly stated 4%, now updated to 2.5%).
 Binding Ice now roots the afflicted player for 3 seconds, down from 4 seconds.
 Meteor Rain's fragments now have 10% smaller hit boxes.
 The killscore break points that cause Malevolent Spirits to appear is now every 12% in dungeons and 24% in adventures, down from every 10% in dungeons and 20% in adventures.
 Carnage now causes 10% of all damage dealt by players being replicated as healing on the group, down from 20%.
 Challenge now increases non-boss enemies' health and damage by 10%, down from 15%.
 Ultimatum now increases boss health and damage by 10%, down from 15%.

DEMONIC RITUAL
PROPHET EZ'RATH

 Wicked Hook ability is now visible on the boss timer.
 Increased minimum range of Wicked Hook to 1500 (was 1000).
 Wicked Hook's initial damage reduced by 35%.

ICE CAVES
ELDRIN ASSASSIN

 Poison Dagger initial damage reduced by 24%.

CITHREL'S ASCENT
BLADE OF CITHREL

 Ice Breaker damage reduced by 17%.

notes.title: Share a Review for the Steam Next Fest Demo!
notes.content:
Hello Fellows! 

We've opened up a separate Steam Demo page (see below) to give YOU the chance to leave to a review of the demo and share your feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487890/Fellowship_Demo/

The feedback we've already received in Fellowship's Discord and social media channels has been incredible, to say the least, and extremely helpful, and so we'd figured to give you all the chance to leave an official review. 

Fellowship will be a constantly evolving adventure, and your reviews will help us discover even more ways to evolve Fellowship before it launches in Early Access on PC later this year. 

Looking forward to reading your all's reviews and feedback. Thank you again for jumping into Fellowship's Steam Next Fest Demo!

- The Chief Rebel Team

notes.title: Public Playtest Now Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

The moment you’ve all been patiently waiting for is here: Our Fellowship Public Playtest is now live as part of Steam Next Fest: February Edition! You can jump right into the playtest for free, no signup or key required. This playtest will be running until March 3 at 10am PT (7pm CET), so make the most of it! If you’d like to discuss the game or team up with fellow dungeon crawlers, we invite you to join our Fellowship Discord. 

Before jumping in, in case you missed it, we recommend you check out our latest trailer [here] that covers everything you need to know before going on dungeon runs in Fellowship. 

We also recommend looking over our Known Issues blog for more details on issues we're aware of for the playtest. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/48a158acd5eb34f3a1654bd38eabf628aeb780e9.jpg

FAQ 


There really is no signup, payment or key required? 

Correct, there is no need to sign up, key or fee required for this Public Playtest. It’s free and publicly available as part of Steam Next Fest.  

How do I get into the Public Playtest? 

 Head to Fellowship’s Steam page, download the playtest build (it’ll be shown as a “Demo”) and once it’s downloaded, you can jump in and play. 

When can I play exactly? 

Steam Next Fest and the Public Playtest runs from 2/24 at 10am PT (7pm CET) to 3/3 at 10 am PT (7pm CET) and Fellowship will be fully playable for that whole time.  

Can I stream/capture my gameplay? 

There is no NDA for this playtest. Streaming/video capture and talking about the playtest is encouraged! 

What Heroes are available? 

There will be 6 heroes for players to choose from during the Public Playtest: 2 Tanks, 2 DPS, and 2 Healers. We have added a new Melee DPS, Tariq, to this playtest that wasn't available in the Closed Alpha. 

Is there any new content in the Public Playtest compared to the last playtest, the Closed Alpha playtest last August?   

There is! Compared to the Closed Alpha playtest back in August 2024, in addition to introducing a new DPS hero, Tariq, the Public Playtest introduces new gameplay systems, like a unique gem system and an item transmutation system, world and party chat, new Curses, new Gear, new Mounts, new visual element improvements and reworks of previous gameplay mechanics based on Closed Alpha playtest player feedback. 

Will there be servers in my region? 

There are NA, EU, and Asian servers available during the Public Playtest. 

What languages are the Playtest available in? 
The playtest is available in English only as we're currently working on the localization process for additional languages. 

How do I share my feedback? 

Join our Discord! Feedback can be shared in the ⁠#game-feedback channel. 

What do I do if I encounter an issue during the Public Playtest? 

As this is still a Beta build, you may occasionally encounter issues with your game. If you do, please report them in the ⁠#bug-reports ⁠channel on Discord so our teams can track them.

notes.title: Public Playtest Known Issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Before you jump into the Public Playtest, below's a quick list of Known Issues we're aware of!

If you run into any other issues, let us know in our Discord: https://discord.gg/6xrCTVbMj2 

Known Issues

Friends List - “how do I group up with my friends?”

The only way to group up with your friends when in different strongholds - is to use Fellowship’s in-game Friends List feature.

 The Friends List is the green icon in the bottom right corner of your screen.
 Add friends by using the Friend Code generated in the Fellowship’s Friend’s List feature. For this build, you will need to send that code to your friend using an external chat program.
 The Friends List does not indicate that players are outside of your region. Party members playing in different regions will never be put into the same Stronghold. When starting a mission, all players in a party will be put into a dungeon server in the Party Leaders region. This can lead to high ping or latency issues if the host is playing in a different region than you.
 The Friends List will display your friend as offline if they are not in the game or logged. (Ignores Steam)
 Friends List uses a placeholder hero icon until a friend switches heroes.
 Friends List will use a generic Fellowship icon if it cannot access the player’s Steam icon.


Party

 Party Frames do not update to include players outside of your Stronghold server. Reference the big ‘Party Portraits’ in the top left corner of your screen while you are in the Stronghold for the source of truth for who is in your party.
 It is possible to be invited to a new party while currently in a party. Accepting the invite will remove you from your current party.


Game Finder

 Players can find/host a Dungeon at a difficulty below the unlock difficulty level.
 This can lead to long waits for Dungeon queues, because players on lower difficulties cannot access those dungeons.
 We suggest players find/host dungeons at higher difficulties than they are unlocked at. 
 Cithrel’s Ascent (+3)
 Demonbrand Ruins (+4)
 Wraithtide Isle (+6)
 Potential Rewards will suggest that Set Items can drop from Adventures. They do not.
 Next Unlock section will vanish when there is not an Unlock for completing the next available difficulty.
 Button Glows seem to ‘hop’ up when clicked.
 Premade groups cannot play quickplay if they defy holy trinity party composition (1 Tank, 1 Healer, 2 Damage Dealers). Groups wanting to make experimental party comps should ‘Host Game’ with a full group. 
 


Settings
Graphic Settings

 Auto-Save and Auto-Apply are behaving strangely. Keep them toggled on.
 With this, Graphic Settings will automatically apply (Apply and Cancel do nothing).
 Auto-Detect button cannot be trusted to detect the ideal Graphic Settings for you. Do not use it!


Talent Tree

 The text description suggests that players need to complete a specific difficulty to unlock.
 This is misleading because players only ‘Unlock’ new features by completing the Next Unlock track visible in the Game Finder.
 Example: To unlock the first row of talents players need to complete equal or higher than a +0, +1, and +2. You cannot be carried through a +2 to immediately unlock these. You’ll need to complete a minimum of 3x missions to access.


Map

 Training Dummies suggest they offer 100% killscore. Do not be misled… There is no killscore in the Stronghold.
 Some filters are misnamed or not functioning in the Stronghold.
 Bosses may not be visible if they are far away from you when you open the Map.


HUD Edit Mode

 Several HUD elements are only editable in an Adventure/Dungeon, while others are only editable within Stronghold.
 Some HUD elements have unusually sized boxes that do not depict the actual size of the correlating HUD UI.


General UI

 Several UI windows will ‘jitter’ when opened.
 Several UI windows will not auto-close when another window is opened. They will reopen themselves when another UI window is closed.
 This can lead to several instances of UI existing simultaneously behind each other.
 Simply closing these windows with the [X] button in the UI will close them.
 UI Windows do not close when changing characters. 
 This can lead to broken UI when changing heroes if you have not closed UI windows prior.
 In the Stronghold, player names above the heroes head do not adjust their height. This is most noticeable while observing mounted heroes. (Especially Tariq)
 Tutorial Quests will not disappear until you interact with their specific interactable object in the Stronghold, even though you can access all UI through the bottom right Quick Access Menu.
 After receiving a Mount, the Mailbox will suggest you have mail, when you do not.
 Opening the Hero Sheet and the Hero Select at the same time will break the view model rigs for heroes in the Hero Select screen - thus creating truly unhinged abominations.

notes.title: Announcing: Fellowship
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BuhVdx9K0Fc;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re excited to announce Fellowship, the first-ever multiplayer online dungeon adventure (“MODA”) game. Fellowship is developed by Chief Rebel, a new game studio based in Stockholm, Sweden with industry veterans who’ve worked on critically-acclaimed video game franchises. With Fellowship, it will take fan-favorite elements of MMOs, MOBAs and ARPGs, including thrilling endgame dungeon runs, a diverse roster of heroes, cooperative, team-focused gameplay and epic loot, to give players a truly unique and challenging yet accessible PvE dungeon crawling experience. Fellowship will be a premium, not free-to-play or subscription-based title and is set to launch on PC in 2025.

There will be a Closed Alpha playtest on Steam from August 15 to 20, find out all details and how to sign up in this article!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/64071f92c4ecbd4e63ab59d1833d6b0c8d8bec82.jpg
ABOUT FELLOWSHIP

Fellowship is a multiplayer online dungeon adventure set in an exciting fantasy setting, with endlessly scaling dungeon runs. Players must focus on working together as a team, with an emphasis on skill, cooperation, and strategy to defeat bosses, collect loot, and work together to overcome ever-present challenges. Experience the “Holy Trinity” and build the ultimate team of tanks, healers and damage dealers to take down hordes of enemies and imposing bosses. Work together with your friends to overcome the greatest challenges, creating unbreakable bonds and memorable moments. Players can also flex their individual skills on the competitive leaderboards that show where you stand in Fellowship. Persevere, overcome and ascend through the top ranks in Fellowship!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/358cad034cbaed50a181a8b60c9528fbd289c410.jpg
GAME FEATURES

GATHER YOUR PERFECT TEAM - Play alongside your friends in teams with 4 Player Co-op Multiplayer in a rich, fantasy world full of challenging enemies and exciting rewards. Swap between a large pool of tank, healer and DPS roles with unique kits to build the perfect balance for your team.

ENDLESS SCALING REPLAYABILITY - Every run will feel like a brand-new challenge with dungeons that will get more difficult as players progress and level up. Players will never out level the game with seasonal updates, dungeon modifiers, new features and rewards that will keep each run fresh and exciting, adding another layer of replayability.

UNIQUE AND COMPLEX BOSS MECHANICS - Each boss has unique and varied mechanics, for a fresh experience every run. Enemy skills grow as difficulty increases and additional modifiers continue to challenge players as they grow and improve.

REWARDS, LOOT, AND GEAR GALORE - After each completed dungeon run, players will earn loot to make their characters even more powerful! The tougher the dungeon, the better the rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/a4aa5070b08b5e5d36ae7374a84ab0e419a0e4fa.jpg
JOIN THE DISCUSSION

We’d love to hear from you! Join our official Discord to discuss the game with fellow fans and with the developers as we reveal more details about Fellowship in the future!
